text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":391475,"ns":0,"title":"Category mistake","extract":"A category mistake (or category error, categorical mistake, or mistake of category) is a semantic or ontological error in which things belonging to a particular category are presented as if they belong to a different category, or, alternatively, a property is ascribed to a thing that could not possibly have that property. An example is a person learning that the game of cricket involves team spirit, and after being given a demonstration of each player's role, asking which player performs the \"team spirit\".","description":"Ascribing an impossible property to a thing","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
